- Exec comms: Kimberly will send an exec-facing note to Medisphere and our leadership today.
- Postmortem: target draft within 72 hours; public postmortem and remediation plan in 7 days.

Appreciate Medisphere’s patience and quick coordination. I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link and the finance-backed credit proposal in the next hour.
